presets.name: Alpamayo 2-Camera (front wide + tele)
presets.description: Lean Alpamayo 1.5 input rig: camera indices [1, 6] at the model-native 512x384 render size. Recommended NF4 closed-loop profile.

presets.name: Alpamayo 4-Camera (dataset default)
presets.description: Alpamayo 1.5 dataset-default input rig: camera indices [0, 1, 2, 6] at the model-native 512x384 render size.

presets.name: Alpamayo 6-Camera (A2 Super driving)
presets.description: Alpamayo 2 Super trajectory/meta-action/auto-labeling input rig: camera indices [0, 1, 2, 3, 5, 6] at the model-native 512x384 render size. Requires an 80 GiB-class device; local execution is unqualified.

presets.name: Alpamayo 6-Camera (A2 Super VQA)
presets.description: Alpamayo 2 Super VQA/grounding input rig: camera indices [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5] at the model-native 512x384 render size.

presets.name: Drone Inspection: Wide Gimbal
presets.description: One stabilized wide RGB camera (75 deg HFOV) on the payload gimbal. Generic DJI-style modeled optics (declared horizontal FOV, zero distortion), not a calibrated device claim. Cameras record the profile capture; on a drone carrier Training and Showcase capture 24 fps.

presets.name: Drone Inspection: Wide + Zoom Gimbal
presets.description: Stabilized wide (75 deg) and fixed optical zoom (13 deg) RGB cameras sharing the payload gimbal, 4 cm apart. Generic DJI-style modeled optics (declared horizontal FOV, zero distortion), not a calibrated device claim. Cameras record the profile capture; on a drone carrier Training and Showcase capture 24 fps.

presets.name: Drone Mapping: Nadir RGB
presets.description: One stabilized mapping RGB camera (72 deg HFOV, 4:3) on the payload gimbal; nadir when the flight's gimbal is at its default -90 deg pitch. Perspective, not orthographic. Generic DJI-style modeled optics (declared horizontal FOV, zero distortion), not a calibrated device claim. Cameras record the profile capture; on a drone carrier Training and Showcase capture 24 fps.

presets.name: Drone FPV: Forward Body Camera
presets.description: One body-fixed forward RGB camera (110 deg HFOV) at the nose, level with the body: it turns and tilts with the drone, never the gimbal. Generic DJI-style modeled optics (declared horizontal FOV, zero distortion), not a calibrated device claim. Cameras record the profile capture; on a drone carrier Training and Showcase capture 24 fps.
